items.title: Jim Chalmers says he doesn't expect a recession, but 'things might get a bit harder'
items.summary: The Treasurer said the government was on track for cuts to more than cover any new spending in next month's mid-year budget update and that forecasts would project higher unemployment and lower growth.

items.title: Tech stocks surge as Nvidia rally adds $2 trillion to Nasdaq 100
items.summary: US technology stocks staged a broad rally Monday, with gains across chipmakers, AI infrastructure providers and software companies adding nearly $2 trillion to the Nasdaq 100's market capitalization as investors welcomed Jensen Huang's return to Nvidia Corp (NASDAQ:NVDA, XETRA:NVD). items.title: Downer shares jump over 3% on $730 million NSW transmission contract
items.summary: Investing.com -- Downer EDI shares rose more than 3% on Monday after the Australian infrastructure group secured an about A$1.1 billion ($730 million) contract to deliver transmission line works for the Hunter Transmission Project in New South Wales.

aus.headline: Chalmers Rules Out Recession
aus.body: Treasurer says cuts will cover new spending as the jobs and growth outlook weakens.
aus.why: The budget update points to a tougher year for jobs and growth.

us.headline: Tech Rally Adds Nearly $2 Trillion
us.body: US tech shares jumped Monday as Jensen Huang returned to lead Nvidia.
us.why: Many Australians hold US tech shares through their super.

biz.headline: Downer Wins $1.1b Power Line Deal
biz.body: Downer EDI shares rose over 3% after it landed a big NSW transmission contract.
biz.why: It is a major local infrastructure job in the Hunter region of NSW.
